title: Nexus Infotech Pvt. Ltd. v. Bharat Cloud Solutions LLP
summary: Commercial suit claiming damages and permanent injunction regarding alleged breach of Enterprise Cloud Services Agreement. Core dispute hinges on SLA breach penalties, unilateral arbitration clause validity under Perkins Eastman, and admissibility of server timestamp logs under Section 63 BSA.

title: Vikramaditya Singhania v. State of Maharashtra & Anr.
court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
oppositeParty: State of Maharashtra (C.R. No. 142/2026, Cyber Crime Police Station)
opposingCounsel: Chief Public Prosecutor, Govt. of Maharashtra
summary: Application under Section 482 BNSS (erstwhile Section 438 CrPC) for grant of anticipatory bail in an alleged corporate cyber fraud complaint. The applicant has submitted full audit logs and demonstrated compliance with notice of appearance under Section 35(3) BNSS, relying on Satender Kumar Antil and Arnesh Kumar guidelines.

title: IndoPharma BioTech Ltd. v. Apex Generics India
statutesInvolved: Indian Stamp Act 1899 (Stamp Duty Admissibility Test)
summary: Petition for appointment of sole independent arbitrator pursuant to Clause 19 of Technology Transfer Agreement. Opposite party raised objection alleging deficiency in stamp duty under Karnataka Stamp Act following the 7-judge Constitution Bench ruling in Re: Interplay between Arbitration Agreements and Stamp Act.
